description: Situated just steps from Carson Elementary and Temple Emanuel and a short stroll to Robinson & Cranmer Park, this Mediterranean-style Hilltop residence delivers the character of an established neighborhood with the comfort of a move-in-ready home. An open floor plan showcases oversized arched windows, coffered and beamed ceilings, classic wainscoting, rich hardwood floors, and abundant natural light. The chef's kitchen features professional-grade appliances, quartz countertops, an expansive island, and a butler's pantry connecting to the formal dining room. Upstairs, three spacious bedrooms include a luxurious primary suite with a five-piece bath, while a versatile loft could be enclosed to create a fifth bedroom. The finished lower level offers a generous media and recreation room, wine cellar, wet bar, and private guest room. Designed for effortless indoor-outdoor entertaining, the home features a backyard, covered patio with remote-controlled heaters, built-in barbecue, outdoor refrigerator, and whole-home speaker system. Recent improvements include a DaVinci roof, refreshed interior and exterior paint, updated lighting and LED fixtures, new HVAC systems and water heaters, refreshed landscaping, exterior uplighting, a redone driveway, and a finished garage with epoxy flooring and custom storage.
